thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: P2 - elevated tail latency and increased 5xx in eu-west1 proxy tier. Pager: maya

maya: I'm on it — pulling traces and recent deploys. collecting context. :eyes:

maya: Observed spike starting ~21:15 UTC. 95p latency from ~1.2s -> ~3.9s, error rate up to 2.6% across proxy pool.

ronen: tagging infra team, @infra-sre can you confirm provider telemetry (provider-a/provider-b)? Any network blips?

infra-sre: we see small sustained packet loss to provider-a in eu-west1 starting 21:14, and a subset of proxy hosts show high CPU due to long-lived requests. Not a clear host kill yet.

lee: can we gate long-polling and reduce simultaneous handshakes? Suggest soft per-route rate cap + splay first to reduce head-of-line.

maya: Plan proposal: 1) soft ratecap on streaming/chat route 2) disable noncritical analytics enrichment for eu-west1 (degrade) 3) enable degraded-mode fallback for streaming endpoints. Monitor metrics, escalate to provider reroute or partial region failover only if these don't stabilize.

cassie: Product impact note: disabling enrichment will remove extra fields for logs/dashboards for a subset of customers (low severity) — will inform customer success.

product-ops: notifying top-affected customers now with template (low-sev mitigation).

ops-runner: running ratecap command now:
```bash
rctl set-ratecap --region eu-west1 --route /v1/chat/stream --limit 40 --splay 10 --mode soft
```
ops-runner: applied to rolling pools (~120 instances) — rollout windows 30s.

incident-bot: Action taken: soft-ratecap updated by ops-runner at 21:22 UTC.

maya: Applying feature toggle for analytics enrichment (eu-west1 only):
```json
{"feature":"enrich-analytics","action":"disable","scope":"eu-west1","reason":"mitigation"}
```
ops-runner: feature toggle pushed via config-service canary 5% -> 100% over 3m.

ronen: also kicking off light traffic shaping: move ~20% new sessions off provider-a -> provider-b to ease provider-a queues. Command:
```bash
trafficctl reroute --from provider-a --to provider-b --region eu-west1 --percent 20 --splay true
```

infra-sre: reroute in progress. backend queue depth shows improvement within ~90s for affected hosts.

maya: Monitoring: 21:25 UTC snapshot: 95p latency dropped to ~2.2s, error rate down to ~1.1%. Continuing mitigation for 10m and reassess. :white_check_mark:

cassie: Customer impact summary posted to support channel — missing enrichment fields noted, dashboards degraded for non-critical views.

product-ops: outbound customer emails queued and sent.

lee: Suggest keep degraded-mode + soft ratecap until provider-a fully recovers, and prep a circuit-breaker for aggressive retry storms.

maya: Handing off live watch to night oncall @ronen — will stay reachable. If metrics regress >50% of initial spike, escalate to region failover runbook (link: https://runbooks/redwood/region-failover).

ronen: Acknowledged. I'll monitor 21:30/21:40 metrics and coordinate rollback when safe. Will trigger partial brownout (noncritical routes) if we see repeated oscillation.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied — status: mitigated (monitoring). Next update scheduled 21:40 UTC or on any significant change. :information_source:

maya: Leaving note: mitigation prioritized preserving overall availability while sacrificing nonessential telemetry. Good catch on splay + soft caps — helped reduce the tail. :thumbsup:

ronen: Copy that, watching dashboards. :eyes:
